passages.text: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—in the Arabah opposite Suph—between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
\r\nMoses spoke to all the people of Israel.
\r\nHe spoke while they were in the wilderness.
\r\nThey were east of the Jordan River.
\r\nThey were in the Arabah, which is a desert plain.
\r\nThey were opposite Suph.
\r\nThey were between Paran and Tophel.
\r\nThey were also between Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
\r\nThese are the words that Moses spoke to Israel in that place.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֡ר בָּֽעֲרָבָה֩ מ֨וֹל ס֜וּף בֵּֽין־ פָּארָ֧ן וּבֵֽין־ תֹּ֛פֶל וְלָבָ֥ן וַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וְדִ֥י זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
He spoke in the wilderness east of the Jordan.
He spoke after they had left Horeb.
Horeb is the mountain where God spoke to Israel.
Kadesh-barnea is a place near the border of the promised land.
The journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea takes eleven days.
The road passes by Mount Seir.
passages.original: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽחֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD had given Moses commands for the Israelites.
In the fortieth year after leaving Egypt, Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He spoke on the first day of the eleventh month.
Moses told the Israelites everything the LORD had commanded him about them.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ בְּאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
He defeated Sihon.
Sihon was king of the Amorites.
Sihon lived in Heshbon.
Moses also defeated Og.
Og was king of Bashan.
Og lived in Ashtaroth.
Moses defeated Og at Edrei.
passages.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י הַכֹּת֗וֹ אֵ֚ת סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְאֵ֗ת ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ת בְּאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃

passages.text: On the east side of the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb: “You have stayed at this mountain long enough.
passages.sermon:
Moses was in the land of Moab.
This land was on the east side of the Jordan River.
Moses began to explain the law to the Israelites.
He spoke to them.
He said, “The LORD is our God.
The LORD spoke to us at Horeb.
The LORD said, ‘You have stayed at this mountain long enough.’”
passages.original: בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב הוֹאִ֣יל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּאֵ֛ר אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לֵאמֹֽר׃ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחֹרֵ֣ב לֵאמֹ֑ר רַב־ לָכֶ֥ם שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the foothills, in the Negev, and along the seacoast to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great River Euphrates.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites in the land of Moab.
He explained God's command to them.
God told the Israelites to resume their journey.
God told them to go to the hill country of the Amorites.
God told them to go to all the neighboring peoples.
These peoples lived in the Arabah.
They lived in the hill country.
They lived in the foothills.
They lived in the Negev.
They lived along the seacoast.
God told the Israelites to go to the land of the Canaanites.
God told them to go to Lebanon.
God told them to go as far as the great River Euphrates.
passages.original: פְּנ֣וּ׀ וּסְע֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם וּבֹ֨אוּ הַ֥ר הָֽאֱמֹרִי֮ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ שְׁכֵנָיו֒ בָּעֲרָבָ֥ה בָהָ֛ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֥ה וּבַנֶּ֖גֶב וּבְח֣וֹף הַיָּ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַלְּבָנ֔וֹן עַד־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃

passages.text: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites through Moses.
God is the LORD.
God promised to give land to the Israelites.
God made this promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
God also promised this land to their descendants.
God placed the land in front of the Israelites.
God told the Israelites to enter the land.
God told them to take possession of the land.
passages.original: רְאֵ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֚אוּ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע יְ֠הוָה לַאֲבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֔ם וּלְזַרְעָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: At that time I said to you, “I cannot carry the burden for you alone.
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the Israelites at that time.\r\nMoses said, "I cannot carry you by myself."\r\nMoses could not bear the responsibility for the people alone.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל לְבַדִּ֖י שְׂאֵ֥ת אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has made you many.
Today you are very numerous.
You are as many as the stars in the sky.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם הִרְבָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
He promised to bless you.
May the LORD increase you a thousand times more.
May the LORD bless you.
He will do as He promised.
passages.original: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֽוֹתֵכֶ֗ם יֹסֵ֧ף עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כָּכֶ֖ם אֶ֣לֶף פְּעָמִ֑ים וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses was their leader.
The Israelites had many troubles.
They had many burdens.
They had many disputes.
Moses asked a question.
He said, "How can I carry all your troubles by myself?"
He said, "How can I carry all your burdens alone?"
He said, "How can I handle all your disputes alone?"
passages.original: אֵיכָ֥ה אֶשָּׂ֖א לְבַדִּ֑י טָרְחֲכֶ֥ם וּמַֽשַּׂאֲכֶ֖ם וְרִֽיבְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He told them to choose men from each tribe.
These men must be wise.
These men must have understanding.
These men must be respected.
Moses said he would appoint these men as leaders.
passages.original: הָב֣וּ לָ֠כֶם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים חֲכָמִ֧ים וּנְבֹנִ֛ים וִידֻעִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשִׂימֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
passages.sermon:
The people listened to me.
They answered me.
They said, “What you have said is good.”
They agreed with my proposal.
passages.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֖וּ אֹתִ֑י וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טֽוֹב־ הַדָּבָ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
passages.sermon:
I took the leaders from your tribes.
These men were wise.
These men were respected.
I appointed these men as your leaders.
Some became commanders over thousands.
Some became commanders over hundreds.
Some became commanders over fifties.
Some became commanders over tens.
I also made some of them officers for your tribes.
passages.original: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־ רָאשֵׁ֣י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים חֲכָמִים֙ וִֽידֻעִ֔ים וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: At that time I charged your judges: “Hear the disputes between your brothers, and judge fairly between a man and his brother or a foreign resident.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses appointed judges over the people.
At that time, Moses gave a command to the judges.
Moses said to the judges, "Listen to the disputes between your brothers."
Judge each case with fairness.
Judge fairly between a man and his brother.
Judge fairly between a man and a foreign resident.
passages.original: וָאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־ שֹׁ֣פְטֵיכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין־ אֲחֵיכֶם֙ וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־ אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־ אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be intimidated by anyone, for judgment belongs to God. And bring to me any case too difficult for you, and I will hear it.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the judges of Israel.
He gave them instructions about judging cases.
Do not show favoritism in judgment.
Treat every person the same in court.
Listen to the small and the great alike.
Do not be afraid of anyone.
Judgment belongs to God.
If a case is too hard for you, bring it to me.
I will hear it.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תַכִּ֨ירוּ פָנִ֜ים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט כַּקָּטֹ֤ן כַּגָּדֹל֙ תִּשְׁמָע֔וּן לֹ֤א תָג֙וּרוּ֙ מִפְּנֵי־ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט לֵאלֹהִ֣ים ה֑וּא וְהַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְשֶׁ֣ה מִכֶּ֔ם תַּקְרִב֥וּן אֵלַ֖י וּשְׁמַעְתִּֽיו׃

passages.text: And at that time I commanded you all the things you were to do.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
He gave them instructions.
He told them everything they must do.
He commanded them at that time.
passages.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃

passages.text: And just as the LORD our God had commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites, through all the vast and terrifying wilderness you have seen. When we reached Kadesh-barnea, I said: “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD commanded us to leave Horeb.
We obeyed the LORD.
We traveled from Horeb.
We walked through a vast wilderness.
The wilderness was great and terrifying.
You saw this wilderness.
We went by the way that leads to the hill country of the Amorites.
The LORD our God told us to go this way.
We came to Kadesh-barnea.
I spoke to you at Kadesh-barnea.
I said, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites.
The LORD our God is giving this land to us.”
passages.original: וַנִּסַּ֣ע מֵחֹרֵ֗ב וַנֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדוֹל֩ וְהַנּוֹרָ֨א הַה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֹתָ֑נוּ וַנָּבֹ֕א עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃ וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם בָּאתֶם֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has put the land in front of you.
You can see the land now.
Go up and take the land.
The LORD, who is the God of your fathers, told you to do this.
Do not be afraid.
Do not be discouraged.
passages.original: רְ֠אֵה נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ עֲלֵ֣ה רֵ֗שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־ תֵּחָֽת׃

passages.text: Then all of you approached me and said, “Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter.”
passages.sermon:
All of you came to me.
You said, “Let us send men ahead of us.”
Let these men explore the land for us.
Let them bring us a report.
Let them tell us which way we should go.
Let them tell us which cities we will enter.
passages.original: וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַי֮ כֻּלְּכֶם֒ וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ נִשְׁלְחָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ־ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיָשִׁ֤בוּ אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲלֶה־ בָּ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: The plan seemed good to me, so I selected twelve men from among you, one from each tribe.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
The people suggested a plan to Moses.
Moses thought the plan was good.
Moses chose twelve men from the people.
Moses chose one man from each tribe.
passages.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב בְּעֵינַ֖י הַדָּבָ֑ר וָאֶקַּ֤ח מִכֶּם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃

passages.text: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
These men left the camp.
They went up into the hill country.
They traveled until they reached the Valley of Eshcol.
They explored the land there.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנוּ֙ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֑ל וַֽיְרַגְּל֖וּ אֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, carried it down to us, and brought us word: “It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
passages.sermon:
Twelve men went to the land.
They took fruit from the land in their hands.
They brought the fruit down to us.
They gave us a report.
They said, “The land is good.”
The LORD our God is giving us this land.
passages.original: וַיִּקְח֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיּוֹרִ֖דוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וַיָּשִׁ֨בוּ אֹתָ֤נוּ דָבָר֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טוֹבָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
passages.sermon: You did not want to go up.\r\nYou refused to obey.\r\nYou rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א אֲבִיתֶ֖ם לַעֲלֹ֑ת וַתַּמְר֕וּ אֶת־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You grumbled in your tents and said, “Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites grumbled in their tents.
They spoke against the LORD.
They said the LORD hated them.
They said the LORD brought them out of Egypt.
They believed the LORD wanted to give them to the Amorites.
They thought the Amorites would destroy them.
passages.original: וַתֵּרָגְנ֤וּ בְאָהֳלֵיכֶם֙ וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בְּשִׂנְאַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔נוּ הוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛נוּ בְּיַ֥ד הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לְהַשְׁמִידֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying: ‘The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke with fear and doubt.
They said, "Where can we go?"
Our brothers discouraged us.
They said, "The people in the land are greater than we are."
They are taller than we are.
Their cities are very large.
Their cities have strong walls that reach up to the sky.
We also saw the descendants of the Anakim there.
The Anakim are a people known for their great size and strength.
passages.original: אָנָ֣ה׀ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹלִ֗ים אַחֵינוּ֩ הֵמַ֨סּוּ אֶת־ לְבָבֵ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר עַ֣ם גָּד֤וֹל וָרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצוּרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־ בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָקִ֖ים רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: So I said to you: “Do not be terrified or afraid of them!
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the Israelites.\r\nHe said, "Do not be terrified of the Amorites.\r\nDo not be afraid of them."
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם לֹא־ תַֽעַרְצ֥וּן וְֽלֹא־ תִֽירְא֖וּן מֵהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD goes before you.
The LORD will fight for you.
You saw the LORD fight for you in Egypt.
You saw these things with your own eyes.
You saw the LORD help you in the wilderness.
The LORD your God carried you in the wilderness.
He carried you as a man carries his son.
He carried you in every place you traveled.
He carried you until you reached this place.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה אִתְּכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ וּבַמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נְשָׂאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׂא־ אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ בְּנ֑וֹ בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם עַד־ בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: But in spite of all this, you did not trust the LORD your God, who went before you on the journey, in the fire by night and in the cloud by day, to seek out a place for you to camp and to show you the road to travel.
passages.sermon:
You did not trust the LORD your God.
The LORD your God went before you.
He led you on your journey.
He searched for a place for you to camp.
He showed you the way you should go.
He went before you in fire at night.
He went before you in a cloud by day.
passages.original: וּבַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה אֵֽינְכֶם֙ מַאֲמִינִ֔ם בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ הַהֹלֵ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֜ם בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ לָת֥וּר לָכֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַֽחֲנֹֽתְכֶ֑ם בָּאֵ֣שׁ׀ לַ֗יְלָה לַרְאֹֽתְכֶם֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ וּבֶעָנָ֖ן יוֹמָֽם׃

passages.text: When the LORD heard your words, He grew angry and swore an oath, saying, “Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers, except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD heard your words.
The LORD became angry.
The LORD swore an oath.
He said, “None of the men from this evil generation will see the good land.
I promised to give this land to your fathers.
Only Caleb son of Jephunneh will see it.
I will give Caleb the land where he walked.
I will give this land to his descendants.
Caleb followed the LORD with all his heart.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְצֹ֖ף וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע לֵאמֹֽר׃ אִם־ יִרְאֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדּ֥וֹר הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֚ת הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי לָתֵ֖ת לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃ זֽוּלָתִ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּה֙ ה֣וּא יִרְאֶ֔נָּה וְלֽוֹ־ אֶתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּֽרַךְ־ בָּ֖הּ וּלְבָנָ֑יו יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּ֖א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, and He said, “Not even you shall enter the land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD became angry with me.
He became angry because of you.
The LORD said to me, “You will not enter the land.”
passages.original: גַּם־ בִּי֙ הִתְאַנַּ֣ף יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְלַלְכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר גַּם־ אַתָּ֖ה לֹא־ תָבֹ֥א שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.
passages.sermon:
Joshua is the son of Nun.
Joshua stands before you.
Joshua will enter the land.
You must encourage Joshua.
Joshua will cause Israel to inherit the land.
passages.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְפָנֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יָ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה אֹת֣וֹ חַזֵּ֔ק כִּי־ ה֖וּא יַנְחִלֶ֥נָּה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.
passages.sermon:
Your little ones are your children.
You said your little ones would become captives.
Your children did not know good or evil on that day.
They will enter the land.
I will give the land to them.
They will possess the land.
passages.original: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ יָדְע֤וּ הַיּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּה וְלָהֶ֣ם אֶתְּנֶ֔נָּה וְהֵ֖ם יִירָשֽׁוּהָּ׃

passages.text: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
He told them to turn around.
He commanded them to go into the wilderness.
He directed them to travel by the way that leads to the Red Sea.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּנ֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם וּסְע֥וּ הַמִּדְבָּ֖רָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־ סֽוּף׃

passages.text: “We have sinned against the LORD,” you replied. “We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God has commanded us.” Then each of you put on his weapons of war, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Moses.
They said, “We have sinned against the LORD.”
They said, “We will go up and fight.”
They said, “The LORD our God commanded us to do this.”
Each man put on his weapons for war.
You thought it would be easy to go up into the hill country.
passages.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֣וּ׀ וַתֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלַ֗י חָטָאנוּ֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נַעֲלֶה֙ וְנִלְחַ֔מְנוּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖נוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽתַּחְגְּר֗וּ אִ֚ישׁ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתּ֔וֹ וַתָּהִ֖ינוּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת הָהָֽרָה׃

passages.text: But the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He is the God of Israel.
He told me to give you a message.
He said, “Do not go up.
Do not fight.
I am not among you.
If you go, your enemies will defeat you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹ֤א תַֽעֲלוּ֙ וְלֹא־ תִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י אֵינֶ֖נִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּֽגְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
passages.sermon:
I spoke to you.
You did not listen to me.
You rebelled against the command of the LORD.
You acted proudly.
You went up into the hill country.
passages.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּמְרוּ֙ אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתָּזִ֖דוּ וַתַּעֲל֥וּ הָהָֽרָה׃

passages.text: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
passages.sermon:
The Amorites lived in the hills.
They came out against you.
They chased you.
They chased you like a swarm of bees.
They struck you down in Seir.
They drove you all the way to Hormah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַיֹּשֵׁ֨ב בָּהָ֤ר הַהוּא֙ לִקְרַאתְכֶ֔ם וַיִּרְדְּפ֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה הַדְּבֹרִ֑ים וַֽיַּכְּת֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם בְּשֵׂעִ֖יר עַד־ חָרְמָֽה׃

passages.text: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel returned to the LORD.
They wept before the LORD.
The LORD did not listen to their voice.
The LORD did not pay attention to them.
passages.original: וַתָּשֻׁ֥בוּ וַתִּבְכּ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ בְּקֹ֣לְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א הֶאֱזִ֖ין אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For this reason you stayed in Kadesh for a long time—a very long time.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites stayed in Kadesh.
They remained there for many days.
They stayed for a very long time.
passages.original: וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בְקָדֵ֖שׁ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים כַּיָּמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
